description: Defines data structures and utility functions for serializing and parsing HTTP alternative service header values, supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and QUIC ALTSVC frames.

classes.name: SpdyAltSvcWireFormat
classes.description: Contains static methods and nested structures for handling Alt-Svc wire format serialization and parsing.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative service with protocol ID, host, port, max age, and version vector.

methods.name: ParseHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Parses Alt-Svc header field value into a vector of AlternativeService objects.

methods.name: SerializeHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes a vector of AlternativeService objects into a header field string.

methods.name: SkipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a string view iterator.

methods.name: PercentDecode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded strings into plain text.

methods.name: ParseAltAuthority
methods.description: Parses authority part (host and port) from a string view iterator.

methods.name: ParsePositiveInteger16
methods.description: Parses a positive 16-bit integer from a string view iterator.

methods.name: ParsePositiveInteger32
methods.description: Parses a positive 32-bit integer from a string view iterator.

methods.name: HexDigitToInt
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its integer value.

methods.name: HexDecodeToUInt32
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a 32-bit unsigned integer.
